steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: ❓ Which block should be moved to the [on sprite overlaps sprite] container block so the fossil sprite starts as a fossil and turns into a dinosaur when it overlaps with the archeologist?

Solution: The fossil’s [set sprite image] block should be moved into the [on sprite overlap sprite] container block.
steps.instructions:
When the two sprites overlap in this project, nothing happens! 


Fix the bug in the code so the fossil sprite changes to a dinosaur image when the archeologist sprite overlaps with it.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 4 of White Belt! Before you create your final White Belt project, there are a few neat tricks to learn that could take your game to the next level! In this level, you’ll learn about functions, which are chunks of code that run whenever they are called. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 4:

badges.title: Function Junction
badges.description: Use functions to make something happen at different points in a project.

badges.title: A Whole New Kind of Sprite
Making a Connection
badges.description: Make something happen when 2 different sprites overlap.

badges.title: Right Behind You
badges.description: Set one sprite to follow another sprite.

badges.title: Make It Dazzle
badges.description: Add an effect to any sprite.

badges.title: The End of the Road
badges.description: End the game in a win or loss when something happens in a project.
